children.text: On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page.
Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password and then click on ‘Save’.
After successful registration, the applicant can log in through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password.
On the home page, click on ‘Login’ and the applicant will be redirected to the Login page using your credentials.
Now, click on ‘Services’ and select "Scholarship Services" from the drop-down.
Now, under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘Scheduled Tribe’.
Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’.
Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’.
Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents.
Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’.
Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory.
Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed.
In case of Any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by the Department Authorities.
All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given.
Student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully.
The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student's application.
Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state.

basicDetails.schemeName: Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th

children.text: The applicant should belong to Gujarat.
The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student.
The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to 10th.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant should belong to Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to 10th.

Class 6 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-.
Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-.

schemeContent.benefits_md:
The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships. The amounts are as follows: > **For Boys** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of ₹750/-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. > **For Girls** - Class 1 to Class 5: Annual scholarship of ₹750/-. - Class 6 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. > **For Extremely Backwards Students** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,500/-.
> **Mode of Disbursement:****** The benefits to the beneficiaries will be disbursed through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method. > **Frequency of Disbursement:****** The scholarship is provided annually.

children.text: The scheme "Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th" by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 10th. Through this scheme, scholarships are annually provided to boys, girls, and extremely backward students from Classes 1st to 10th.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th" by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 10th. Through this scheme, scholarships are annually provided to boys, girls, and extremely backward students from Classes 1st to 10th.
